title: Entry Requirements and Enrollment Fees by Linden Membership Tier
content:
Each tier of Linden Memberships has its own entry gate, its own one-time enrollment fee, charged with the first dues, and a payment window: the number of calendar days after enrollment within which the first dues must be paid before the enrollment is abandoned. The minimum age applies to the primary member.

## Entry gate of each tier

| Tier | Entry gate |
|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | Primary member at least 18 years old; the patient's MyLinden portal status is active |
| Linden Essential Membership | Primary member at least 18 years old; the patient has a primary care clinician in the group |
| Linden Family Membership | The members share a household; no more than 6 dependents |
| Linden Plus Membership | Primary member at least 18 years old; the patient has a primary care clinician in the group |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | Primary member at least 18 years old; a physician panel opening exists |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | Primary member at least 21 years old; enrollment on the annual cycle; a physician panel opening exists |

Every requirement listed for a tier is part of that tier's gate.

## Fees, payment window and minimum age

| Tier | Enrollment fee (USD) | Days to pay the first dues | Minimum age of the primary member (years) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | 0.00 | 14 | 18 |
| Linden Essential Membership | 49.00 | 14 | 18 |
| Linden Family Membership | 99.00 | 14 | 0 (no minimum) |
| Linden Plus Membership | 99.00 | 14 | 18 |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | 250.00 | 14 | 18 |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | 500.00 | 14 | 21 |

A minimum age of 0 means the tier sets no minimum age for the primary member. The Linden Connect Virtual Membership charges no enrollment fee.

## Points of judgement

- **Age.** A 19-year-old primary member meets the age requirement of the Linden Essential Membership (18) but not that of the Linden Executive Health Membership (21).
- **Cycle.** The Linden Executive Health Membership is entered only on the annual cycle; an enrollment in it on the monthly cycle does not meet its gate.
- **Panel.** The Linden Premier Concierge Membership and the Linden Executive Health Membership each require a physician panel opening; without one, the gate of either tier is not met.
- **Hypothetical enrollment on the Linden Plus Membership:** the enrollment fee of 99.00 is charged together with the first dues, and the first dues are to be paid within 14 calendar days of enrollment.
